items.quote: I can't say enough about Ramon. He is an amazing person and great painter. Professional, on time, always offers drinks while I am at the job.
Ramon has done several painting jobs for me, both interior and the entire house exterior. He does a great job and does it quickly.
We contacted Ramon to paint the outside of our house. He was so pleasant and professional and most importantly punctual.
